findings.evidence: template/scripts/managed_project_status.py:419–427 reads Status and then performs an unconditional update when the observed value was unset. A concurrent claim between those operations is overwritten. An in-memory probe changed Status to 'In progress' after the read; ensure_item subsequently wrote 'Backlog' and returned success, putting claimed work back into the free queue.
findings.summary: Membership repair can overwrite a concurrently claimed card with Backlog.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/requirement_intake.py:328–339 checks only the repository before calling ensure_project_membership. It never fetches the Issue to check state or type:requirement. Consequently, a closed Requirement or an internal-change Issue without a card can receive a new Backlog item through --requirement.
findings.summary: Explicit reconciliation does not validate that its target is an open Requirement.

findings.evidence: template/scripts/managed_project_status.py:403,419,429 performs three complete item-discovery passes per ensure_item call. An in-memory probe confirmed three Project queries for an existing initialized card with no mutations. template/scripts/requirement_intake.py:339 repeats this for every open Requirement, so bulk recovery requires approximately 3 × Requirement count × Project page count queries.
findings.summary: Bulk reconciliation repeatedly scans the entire Project even when nothing changes.
